name: Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF
whyItRanks: Top US dividend growth fund with high quality screens (cash flow, ROE, 10-year dividend track record).
risks: Underperforms high-growth tech in bull runs
Subject to 15-30% US dividend withholding tax
idealInvestor: Dividend reinvestment champions holding USD directly.

name: VanEck Semiconductor ETF
whyItRanks: Concentrated exposure to the 25 companies driving artificial intelligence hardware (Nvidia, TSMC, Broadcom, ASML).
pros: Direct pure-play on AI chips and fabrication
idealInvestor: High-conviction tech investors willing to weather 30%+ drawdowns.

name: Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF
whyItRanks: Holds every single publicly traded company in the US (over 3,600 stocks) for just 0.03% TER.
pros: Includes small and mid-cap US growth
idealInvestor: Pure passive indexers who want the entire US economy in one ticker.

name: JPMorgan Equity Premium Income ETF
whyItRanks: Generates high monthly cash flow by selling covered calls on large-cap defensive US stocks.
risks: Caps upside potential in strong bull markets
idealInvestor: Investors who need current dollar income without selling principal.

name: 10X S&P Global Dividend Aristocrats ETF
whyItRanks: JSE-listed ETF investing in global blue-chip companies that have increased or maintained dividends for at least 10 consecutive years.
risks: Lags during fast tech-led bull markets
idealInvestor: Tax-free savings investors wanting resilient international dividend payers.

name: Satrix Resi ETF
whyItRanks: Concentrated play on South Africa's mining giants (Anglo American, Gold Fields, Impala Platinum, BHP).
pros: Direct hedge against global commodity price surges
idealInvestor: Tactical investors seeking cyclical commodity upside or inflation hedging.

name: Satrix Indi ETF
whyItRanks: Excludes miners and banks, focusing purely on industrial leaders (Prosus, Naspers, Bidcorp, Richemont).
pros: Massive global offshore earnings inside the JSE
idealInvestor: Investors looking for South Africa's strongest global consumer and tech champions.

name: Satrix Fini ETF
whyItRanks: High-yielding exposure to South Africa's top banking and insurance conglomerates (FirstRand, Standard Bank, Capitec, Sanlam).
pros: South African banks have tier-1 global capital strength
risks: South African macroeconomic and sovereign debt headwinds
High interest rate credit loss cycles
idealInvestor: Income investors seeking domestic financial powerhouses inside a TFSA.

name: 10X S&P 500 ETF
whyItRanks: Popular 10X (formerly CoreShares) feeder fund into Vanguard S&P 500 on the JSE.
idealInvestor: Alternative to SYG500 for investors who prefer 10X management.

name: ARK Innovation ETF
whyItRanks: Actively managed fund targeting disruptive tech (Tesla, Roku, Coinbase, CRISPR, AI). Highly volatile.
pros: High potential upside during speculative tech rallies
idealInvestor: Speculative growth investors who want thematic venture-like exposure with high risk tolerance.

name: iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF (Acc)
whyItRanks: Irish-domiciled UCITS ETF with 15% US withholding tax treaty and automatic dividend accumulation.
pros: Irish domicile reduces US dividend tax from 30% to 15%
risks: Not listed on JSE or DriveWealth US on EasyEquities
idealInvestor: Non-US residents using Interactive Brokers or Saxo Bank.
easyEquitiesAlternative: For JSE ZAR / TFSA: Buy SYG500 (0.19% TER). For EE USD Account: Buy VOO (0.03% TER).

name: Vanguard FTSE All-World UCITS ETF (USD Acc)
eeAccount: Not Available on EasyEquities directly (LSE listed)
whyItRanks: The gold standard Irish UCITS accumulating world ETF for non-US investors avoiding US estate tax.
pros: Irish domicile prevents US estate tax
idealInvestor: International investors using global brokers like Interactive Brokers.
easyEquitiesAlternative: For JSE ZAR / TFSA: Buy 10X GLOBAL (0.25% TER). For EE USD Account: Buy VT (0.07% TER).

name: iShares Core MSCI World UCITS ETF (Acc)
whyItRanks: The most popular European UCITS ETF tracking developed markets worldwide.
idealInvestor: Non-US investors seeking developed global equity via European exchanges.
easyEquitiesAlternative: For JSE ZAR / TFSA: Buy STXWDM (0.35% TER) — which feeds directly into an underlying iShares/Amundi MSCI World vehicle!
